title: Planet Knife Battle
description: Hurl razor knives into spinning cosmic planets without nicking embedded blades—crack each rotating core open to collect rare galactic daggers.
controls: Tap anywhere to launch a knife straight into the spinning planet while avoiding already stuck blades.

zh-CN.title: 星球飞刀大作战
zh-CN.description: 抖音魔性手速星球飞刀大作战：看准旋转星球空隙精准扎入飞刀，绝不撞刀一举劈开星球解锁炫酷神兵！
zh-CN.controls: 瞅准空隙点击屏幕射出飞刀扎入旋转星球，避开已插飞刀劈碎星球即可通关。
